choice.combine: Narrow stream of fast charged gas
choice.with: Gas cloud across the narrow stream

expectation: The stream will strike the cloud and produce a wider disturbance.

effect: The jet has heated and fragmented the cloud; I want to see how that disturbance can spread.
reaction: The loss of the cloud's immediate chance to form stars is a striking consequence.
reason: The broken cloud is the new result most directly connected to the disturbance, but its next interaction is not yet clear.

choice.inspect: Hot broken cloud across the jet

expectation: The inspection will show what the disturbed cloud can interact with next.

effect: The broken cloud expanded into a wide hot cavity, completing the disturbance goal. The remaining question concerns the cold clouds.
reaction: The narrow jet producing a broad cavity is a striking contrast.
reason: The cold clouds sit beside the expanding flow, so the new cavity is a plausible way to carry them outward.

choice.combine: Wide hot cavity in the surrounding gas
choice.with: Cold clouds beside the expanding flow

expectation: The expanding hot gas will push or entrain the cold clouds outward.

effect: The expanding flow has carried the cold clouds outward while their interiors remain cold. Their next destination may answer whether they are lost.
reaction: It is interesting that dense clouds can stay cold within the outflow.
reason: The outer reaches are the natural next location for clouds carried outward.

choice.combine: Cold clouds carried outward by the expanding flow
choice.with: Outer reaches of the merging galaxies

expectation: The clouds will reach the outer galaxy, revealing whether they can return.

effect: The cold clouds fall back toward the centre rather than escaping, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: The outflow becoming a later inflow was a satisfying reversal.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the jet's broken cloud into a broad hot cavity made the scale of its disturbance clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the broken cloud was useful, but it led automatically to its only available interaction, so it felt less like a meaningful choice.

surprise.text: The dense clouds stayed cold while being carried outward, then slowed and returned toward the centre.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the choices followed the visible paths of the jet and clouds.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in seeing what the returning cold gas does next, especially after learning that the outflow did not carry it away permanently.
